name: @bojackduy/opencode-web-bridges
description: OpenCode browser bridges: managed ChatGPT and optional local-built Gemini, with provider and MCP registration for v1 and v2.

scripts.build:installer: bun build src/installer/install.ts --outfile dist/install.js --target node --external jsonc-parser
scripts.build: bun run build:server && bun run build:tui && bun run build:installer
scripts.prepack: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
scripts.release:patch: bun run typecheck && bun test && npm version patch -m "chore: release %s" && git push && git push origin $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)
scripts.release:minor: bun run typecheck && bun test && npm version minor -m "chore: release %s" && git push && git push origin $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)
scripts.release:major: bun run typecheck && bun test && npm version major -m "chore: release %s" && git push && git push origin $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)
